definitions.explanation: The coldest season of the year, typically from December to February in Japan.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}に{雪|ゆき}が{降|ふ}ります。
{冬|ふゆ}は{鍋|なべ}がおいしいです。
examples.english: Hot pot is delicious in winter.

notes: 冬 is associated with New Year (正月), skiing, hot springs, and warm foods like nabe (hot pot). Related: 冬休み (fuyuyasumi, winter vacation), 冬至 (touji, winter solstice), 真冬 (mafuyu, midwinter).
